Travel Support Program 

The Travel Support Program's aim is to facilitate participation of key contributors to the Open Infrastructure Summit & PTG by covering the costs for their travel and accommodation. The OpenStack Foundation sets aside a fund to support this program. If you are a key contributor to a project managed by the OSF and your company does not cover the costs of your travel and accommodation to Denver, Colorado, you can apply for the Travel Support Program. The total amount of the fund is to be divided among the approved key contributors. View more information about the selection process here: https://wiki.openstack.org/wiki/Travel_Support_Pro...

Apply for Travel Support by filling out this application. 

DEADLINE TO APPLY: February 27, 2019
Approved grantees will be notified the week of March 12, 2019.

If you have any questions about the Travel Support Program, please email summit@openstack.org

Interested in donating to the Travel Support Program fund? You can do so on Eventbrite here.  

Visa Information

Get your Summit Visa in 4 Steps

Step 1

Start now: book your hotel, plane ticket, and register for the Summit

Step 2

Complete the Visa Invitation form

Step 3

Visit this websiteto find what is required for your visa interview.

Step 4

Schedule your visa interview at your nearest US embassy or consulate.

How to apply for a Visa

If you require a visa letter to travel to United States for the Open Infrastructure Summit please fill out this form.

Before submitting a request, please check hereif your country is a part of the Visa Waiver Program. The Visa Waiver Program (VWP) allows citizens of participating countries to travel to the United States without a visa for stays of 90 days or less, when they meet all necessary requirements. You can learn more about the Visa Waiver Program here. If you travel on a passport issued by a country NOT on this list, you will require a Visitor Visa to travel to the United States.

Visa Processing Time

As a general planning guideline, if a visa is needed, a foreign traveler should apply for his or her visa as soon as possible, preferably no later than 60 days before the travel date. Processing time for visas vary depending on the office and the time of year. You are encouraged to apply early and to submit complete applications including all supporting documents. Deadline to submit Visa Invitation Letter request

Requests for invitation letters must be received before April 19, 2019. We will send your visa letter to the email you provide on the request form. No hard copies will be sent. Visa invitation letters will be issued within 5 business days after the request has been submitted.
